DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お二人で散歩されますか。案内図のどの道を考えていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you two going for a walk? Which route on the map are you considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人は池の向こうまで行きたいそうですが、私は今日は短く歩いて休みたいです。同じ距離を歩かなくても合流できるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人は池の先だが自分は短く休みたいので別距離で合流を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend wants to go beyond the pond, but today I want a short walk and a rest. I would like advice on meeting up without walking the same distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your friend wants to go past the pond but you want a shorter walk and rest, and ask about meeting after different distances. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別々に歩くなら、戻る場所を先にそろえましょう。ご自身はどこで休みたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you walk separately, agree on where to return first. Where would you like to rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口近くの日陰のベンチがよいです。その周りを少し歩いてからベンチへ戻り、友人の帰りを待つつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口近くの日陰ベンチを休憩地点にして周囲を少し歩き戻って友人を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: A shaded bench near the entrance would be good. I plan to walk a little around it, return to the bench, and wait for my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose a shaded bench near the entrance, walk nearby briefly, return, and wait for your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 位置を案内図で確かめましょう。同じようなベンチがあるので、近くの目印も見ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the location on the map. There are similar benches; shall we look for a nearby landmark too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。ベンチの横の案内板を目印にします。友人にも場所を指してから分かれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベンチ横の案内板を目印にし分かれる前に友人へ指して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will use the information board beside the bench as a landmark. I will point the place out to my friend before we separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the board beside the bench as a landmark and point it out to your friend before separating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待つ間に移動する可能性もありますね。連絡できるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You might move while waiting. Do you have a way to contact them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話を持っています。日陰がなくなって場所を変える場合は、先に友人へ新しい場所を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話を持ち日陰が移り待つ場所を変える前に友人へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my phone. If the shade disappears and I change places, I will tell my friend the new place first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have a phone and will tell your friend before changing waiting places when the shade moves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら合流しやすいですね。ご友人が長く歩く場合、待つ時間は話しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That will make meeting easier. Have you discussed how long to wait if your friend takes a long walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだです。休みたいことを伝えて戻る目安を話し、疲れたら先に帰る場合の連絡も決めておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休みたい希望を伝え帰着目安と先に帰る場合の連絡を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. I will explain that I want to rest, discuss an approximate return time, and agree how to notify them if I get tired and go home first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain your wish to rest and agree on a return estimate and contact if you go home first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お二人で目印と連絡を確かめてからどうぞ。ご自分のペースで、よい散歩を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please confirm the landmark and contact arrangements together before going. Walk at your own pace and enjoy your stroll.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符をお求めになる前に、行き先を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you buy a ticket, may I ask your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅名を音で聞いただけなので、正しい駅を選べるか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 読みだけを聞き正しい目的駅を選べるか心配と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have only heard the station's name spoken, so I worry about choosing the correct station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have only heard the pronunciation and worry about choosing the correct destination station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 漢字の表記や訪問先の案内がわかるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have anything showing the kanji spelling or directions to your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 招待の画面があります。ただ、建物の名前しか書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 招待画面はあるが建物名のみ記載されていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the invitation on my screen. However, it only gives the building's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the invitation screen but it lists only the building name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 建物の名前だけでは駅を確定できません。招待してくれた方に駅名の表記を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The building name alone does not establish the station. Can you check the written station name with the person who invited you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認できます。似た響きの駅があれば、読みだけで選ばないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 招待者へ文字表記を確認し似た読みで判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. If stations sound similar, I will avoid choosing by pronunciation alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the written name with the inviter and not decide from similar sounds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 駅名がわかったら、予定日と乗車区間も併せて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you know the station name, let us also check your travel date and the section you will ride.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今週の土曜日に行きます。帰りの予定は未定なので、行きだけの相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 土曜日に行き帰りは未定のため行きだけ相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am going this Saturday. My return plans are undecided, so I only want advice on the outward journey.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you go Saturday and want only the outward trip because the return is undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず行きの区間を確定し、購入できる切符と方法を担当者に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: First confirm the outward section and ask the staff which tickets can be purchased and how.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅名を文字で送ってもらい、土曜日の行きの切符を改めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 文字の駅名を受け取り土曜日の片道切符を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will have the station name sent in writing and ask again about Saturday's outward ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will receive the station name in writing and discuss Saturday's one-way ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表記が確認できましたら、その画面をお持ちください。訪問先への道順もご確認のうえ、気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once the spelling is confirmed, please bring that screen. Check directions to your destination too, and have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知のどの部分について確認なさりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the notice would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大きく書かれた日付が過ぎていました。もう手続きできないのではと心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知の大きい日付が過ぎ手続き不可か心配と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The date printed in large letters has passed. I am worried that I can no longer complete the procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the large date on the notice has passed and you worry the procedure is no longer possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その日付の前後に何と書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What is written before and after that date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: よく見ると発行日とあります。別の場所に回答という言葉もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発行日の表示と別の回答欄を発見したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Looking closely, it says date of issue. Elsewhere there is also the word response.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you found the issue-date label and a separate response section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発行日と回答期限は意味が異なります。どの項目の期限か担当者に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: An issue date and a response deadline mean different things. Let us ask the person in charge which item the deadline concerns.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 発行日だけで遅れたと判断してしまいました。表題も読んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発行日で判断した誤解を認め通知表題も見てもらうよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I decided I was late just from the issue date. Could you also read the title?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that you judged wrongly from the issue date and ask them to check the notice title. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表題から担当窓口を確認します。通知は封筒も一緒にお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will identify the responsible desk from the title. Do you have the envelope with the notice too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 封筒もあります。表に書かれた部署と、通知の連絡先を照らし合わせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封筒を提示し部署名と通知連絡先を照合したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I would like to compare the department on the front with the contact details in the notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the envelope and say you want to compare its department with the notice's contact details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認してから該当する担当へご案内します。個別の対応はそこでご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, we will direct you to the relevant staff. Discuss your individual case there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 封筒と通知を一緒に示して、回答が必要かと本当の期限を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回答要否と正しい期限を封筒と通知で確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the envelope and notice together and ask whether a response is needed and what the actual deadline is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the response requirement and correct deadline using the envelope and notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認したい点を担当者へ伝えます。書類をまとめてお持ちください。私は次の案内へ戻りますので、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the staff what you want to check. Please keep the documents together. I must return to the next guidance task, so please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めてのご来院ですか。まず用件を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this your first visit to our clinic? First, may I ask what brings you here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めてです。耳が痛くて来ました。必要な書類の画像を探していますが、すぐに見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初診で耳が痛く書類画像がすぐ見つからないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I came because my ear hurts. I am looking for images of the necessary documents but cannot find them right away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that this is your first visit, your ear hurts, and you cannot find the document images quickly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 症状については医療スタッフへお伝えします。画像だけで受付できるかは別に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will tell the medical staff about your symptoms. Whether images alone can be accepted at reception needs a separate check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 画像があればよいと思っていました。今日は実物を持っていないものもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画像で足りると思い実物を持っていない書類もあると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought images would be enough. There are some originals I have not brought today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you thought images were sufficient and have not brought some original documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お持ちのものと持参していないものを担当者へお伝えください。痛みはいつからですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell the staff what you have and have not brought. When did the pain start?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝から、右の耳が痛いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今朝から右耳に痛みがあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My right ear has hurt since this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your right ear has hurt since this morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の説明を引き継ぎます。書類の扱いは受付担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass that explanation on. Let us check document handling with reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ほかの写真まで見せないよう、必要な画像だけ開きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 私的な写真を見せず必要な画像だけ開きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to open only the necessary images so I do not show other photos too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to open only the necessary images without showing private photos. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 提示が必要かを確認してから操作してください。いったん端末をしまっても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check whether showing them is necessary before operating the device. You may put it away for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に受付担当へ持ち物を伝え、画像が必要になったら該当するものだけ開きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持参状況を先に伝え必要な場合のみ該当画像を開くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first tell reception what I brought, and if images are needed, open only the relevant ones.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will first explain what you brought and open the relevant images only if required. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 症状と書類の確認を担当者へ引き継ぎます。端末とお荷物をまとめて、こちらの案内先へお進みください。私は別の受付に戻りますので、ここで失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will hand over your symptoms and document questions to the staff. Gather your device and belongings and proceed to the desk indicated here. I am returning to another reception desk, so I will leave you here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちになった手袋は、拾われたものでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are the gloves you brought ones you found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道で二つ拾いました。似ていますが、同じ人のものかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つ拾ったが同じ人の手袋か不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found two on the road. They look alike, but I do not know if they belong to the same person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you found two gloves but do not know whether they belong to the same person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見つけた場所と時刻を、それぞれ教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the place and time you found each one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つは交差点の手前で、もう一つは少し先のベンチの近くです。どちらも昼ごろでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 交差点手前とベンチ付近で昼ごろ発見したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: One was before the intersection and the other near a bench a little farther on. Both were around noon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you found them before the intersection and near a bench, around noon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所が違うことを記録します。拾う前の写真などはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will record that the locations differ. Do you have photos from before picking them up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真はありません。二つを勝手に一組にせず、別々に袋へ入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真はなく一組と決めず別の袋に分けたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: No photos. Without assuming they were a pair, I put them in separate bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have no photos and put them in different bags without deciding they were a pair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのまま確認します。色や左右について覚えていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check them as they are. Do you remember anything about their color or which hand they are for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 両方黒く見えましたが、右と左は確かめていません。今ここで見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 両方黒いが左右不明で担当者に見てほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Both looked black, but I did not check right and left. Could you look at them here now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that both are black but the hand is unknown, and ask the staff to inspect them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者が確認しますので、ご自分で裏返したりせずお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will check, so hand them over without turning them inside out yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの袋を渡します。場所を間違えないよう、どちらをどこで拾ったか順に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二袋を渡しどちらの発見場所か順に説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hand over both bags and explain in order where I found each, so I do not mix up the locations.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will hand over two bags and explain each finding location in order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 発見状況を分けてお知らせいただき助かります。担当者へ引き継ぎます。お帰りの際も周囲に気をつけてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: It helps that you kept the circumstances separate. I will hand this over to the staff. Watch your surroundings on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居に関する手続きのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about moving procedures?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族のうち私だけ引っ越します。全員の郵便が動くような申込みにならないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族のうち自分だけ転居し全員の郵便が移ることを心配と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only I am moving out of my family. I worry that my application might cause everyone's mail to be redirected.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that only you are moving and you worry about redirecting the whole family's mail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 転居する方の範囲を担当者に伝えて、申込内容を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Explain which people are moving to the staff and check the application details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 親は今の家に残ります。書類には自分の名前だけ書けばよいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 親は旧居に残り自分の名前だけ書くべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My parents will stay in the current house. Should I write only my own name on the form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that your parents remain in the old home and ask whether to enter only your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記入方法は受付担当者に確認してください。ここで対象欄を推測して書かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ask reception how to fill it in. Do not guess which field applies and write here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、まだ書かずに本人の範囲を説明します。引っ越す日は決まっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象範囲を先に説明し転居日は決まっていると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will leave it blank for now and explain who is concerned. The moving date is decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will first explain who is covered and that the moving date is fixed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日付も確認に必要な情報としてお伝えください。新しい住所は正確にわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Give the date too, as information needed for checking. Do you know the exact new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 建物名はわかりますが、部屋番号を家で確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 建物名はわかるが部屋番号は帰宅後の確認が必要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I know the building name, but I need to check the room number at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you know the building name but need to check the room number after returning home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申込みに使う住所を確かめてから進めましょう。今日は方法を相談するだけでも構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us verify the address for the application before proceeding. It is fine just to ask about the method today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 対象が自分だけだと伝えて方法を聞き、部屋番号を確かめたあとで申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人のみ対象の方法を聞き部屋番号を確認後に申し込むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will say that only I am covered and ask the method, then apply after checking the room number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the method for you alone and apply after confirming the room number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご家族の範囲と住所を整理してからお手続きください。本日は案内まで承りました。また確認済みの情報をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please organize the people concerned and address before the procedure. Today we have provided guidance only. Please return with confirmed information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所変更の入力について、止まっている箇所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there a point where you are stuck entering your change of address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい住所を入れたのに、次の画面に古い住所が残っています。まだ送信していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新住所入力後も旧住所が表示され送信していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Although I entered my new address, the old address remains on the next screen. I have not submitted it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the old address remains after entering the new one and you have not submitted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの欄に古い住所が表示されているか、個人情報に配慮して確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check which field shows the old address while protecting your personal information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この欄です。現在の登録と書いてあるので、比較のための表示なのかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在の登録欄を示し比較表示かもしれないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This field. It says current registration, so perhaps it is displayed for comparison.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to the current-registration field and say it may be a comparison display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示の意味は担当者に確認します。勝手に空欄にせず、その状態をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask the staff what it means. Do not clear the field yourself; explain its present state.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 消さずに待ちます。通知の送付先という別の欄も見つけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧表示を消さず通知送付先の別欄もあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait without deleting it. I also found another field called notice delivery address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not delete the old display and there is a separate notice delivery field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所の登録と通知の送付先がどう扱われるか、併せて担当者へ照会しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us ask the staff how address registration and the notice delivery address are handled together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 画面が消えてしまう前に、保存してよい情報と方法も教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 画面が消える前に保存可能な情報と方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before the screen disappears, could you also tell me what information I may save and how?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask which information can be saved and how before the screen disappears. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 画面の保存や提示の方法についても確認します。周囲に見える状態で放置しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also check how to save or show the screen. Do not leave it visible to people around you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 画面を人に見せたままにせず、入力を送る前に二つの欄の意味を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面を他人にさらさず送信前に住所欄と送付先欄の意味を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not leave the screen showing to others, and will ask what the two fields mean before submitting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will protect the screen and ask the meaning of the address and delivery fields before submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 送信を保留して確認するご希望を引き継ぎます。端末は手元で管理してお待ちください。私は担当者へ連絡してまいります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on your request to hold submission and check. Please keep control of your device while waiting. I will contact the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 個包装の商品で、確認したい表示はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there labels you want to check on this individually wrapped product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族と分けたいのですが、小さい袋にも原材料と保存方法が書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族に分ける食品の小袋にも材料と保存法があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to share it with my family. Do the small packets also list the ingredients and storage instructions?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the small food packets to share with family also list ingredients and storage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外袋と個包装では、載っている情報が異なることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The outer bag and individual wrappers may show different information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外袋の原材料は読めました。小さい袋には日付だけがあるように見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外袋の材料は読めるが個包装は日付だけに見えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I could read the ingredients on the outer bag. The small packets seem to show only a date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you can read the outer bag's ingredients but the individual packets seem to have only a date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 包装を開けずに、見える範囲の表示を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the visible labels without opening the packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外袋を捨てると保存の情報がわからなくなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外袋を捨てると保存条件が不明になると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I throw away the outer bag, I may lose the storage information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that discarding the outer bag would leave the storage conditions unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分ける場合も、必要な表示を確認できるようにしておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: When sharing, it is good to keep the necessary labels available too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つの味が入っている商品なので、味ごとに原材料も違うか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二種類の味で原材料の表示が異なるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are two flavors in this product, so I want to know if the ingredients differ for each flavor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the ingredient labeling differs between the two flavors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 味に対応した欄を確認しましょう。一括の表記か分かれた表記かも見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the section corresponding to each flavor. Look whether the labels are combined or separate too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示の対応を読んでから買います。分けたあとも外袋を残して、家族が見られるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 味と材料を照合して購入し小分け後も外袋を家族に残すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will read which labels correspond before buying. After sharing, I will keep the outer bag so my family can see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will match flavors and ingredients before buying and keep the outer bag for family after dividing the food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 必要な情報を確かめてお選びください。ご家族と表示を共有しながら、お買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the information you need when choosing. Enjoy shopping and share the labels with your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 公園の図で、現在地を確認してみましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall we check your current location on the park map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 話しながら歩いていたので、どこから入ったか曖昧になりました。戻る道を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会話中に入口を覚え損ね戻る道を確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was walking while talking and became unsure where we entered. I want to check the way back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you did not remember the entrance while talking and want to check the return route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入るときに覚えている表示や目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember any signs or landmarks when you entered?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の案内に数字がありましたが、番号は覚えていません。近くに広いベンチがありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号は忘れたが入口に数字と広いベンチがあったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There was a number on the entrance sign, but I do not remember it. There was a wide bench nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you forgot the number but there was a number at the entrance and a wide bench. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その情報だけでは入口を特定できません。同行者も覚えているか確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: That information alone cannot identify the entrance. Can you check whether your companion remembers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人に聞きます。私は少し疲れたので、遠回りで一周するのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者に聞くと伝え疲れたため遠回りの一周を避けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask my friend. I am a little tired, so I would like to avoid a long way around the whole park.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask your companion and, being tired, want to avoid a long circuit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず休める場所を現地の表示で確認し、帰り方を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: First, check a place to rest using the local signs, and work out how to return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人が入口の写真を見つけました。これを使えば図と照らし合わせられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者が見つけた入口写真で案内図を確認できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend found a photo of the entrance. Can we use it to compare with the map?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether your companion's entrance photo can be used to check the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真の表示と図を比べて確認しましょう。通れる道は現地の状況にも従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us compare the signs in the photo with the map. Follow local conditions too when deciding which paths are passable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口を確かめてから、近くで休んで同じ道を戻るか友人と決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口を確認して休み同じ道を戻るか友人と相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: After confirming the entrance, I will rest nearby and decide with my friend whether to return by the same route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the entrance, rest, and discuss returning by the same path with your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所が確定するまで急いで進まないでください。休憩を取りながら、気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Do not hurry on before the location is confirmed. Take breaks and have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り場への道をお探しですか。お荷物を持って歩く経路を確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the way to the boarding point? Shall we check a route for walking with your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: かばんが重いので、階段を通らずに行きたいです。地図の近道には階段の印があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重いかばんがあり近道の階段を避けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My bag is heavy, so I want to avoid stairs. The shortcut on the map has a stairs symbol.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have a heavy bag and want to avoid the shortcut's stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 距離だけでなく段差も見て選びましょう。少し遠い道でもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Choose by checking level changes as well as distance. Would a slightly longer route be all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 遠くてもかまいません。途中でかばんを置いて休める場所があれば、先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 遠い経路もよく途中で荷物を置いて休む場所を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not mind a longer route. If there is somewhere to put down the bag and rest along the way, I want to know beforehand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that a longer route is fine and you want to know where to put down your luggage and rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 休む場所と通行できる道を、現在の案内で確認します。乗る予定の便は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check rest places and passable paths using current guidance. Have you decided which service to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 便はまだ決めていません。急いで近道を使うより、歩ける道を確認してから便を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 便は未定で歩ける経路を先に確認してから選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. Rather than rushing along a shortcut, I want to check a walkable route before choosing a service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the service is undecided and you will choose after checking a walkable route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その順番で相談できます。乗り場の番号は、目的地の案内と合わせて確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can discuss it in that order. Check the boarding-point number together with the destination information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乗り場に着いてから階段が必要だと分からないように、最後のところまで教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着時に階段が必要だと困るので乗り場までの経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you explain the route right to the end, so I do not reach the boarding point and discover stairs are required?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the entire route to the boarding point because finding stairs on arrival would be a problem. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗り場までの経路を確認します。途中で通行の案内が違っていたら、無理に進まず係員に尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the route all the way. If passage information differs along the way, do not force your way onward; ask a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乗り場まで段差を確認し、休める場所も覚えます。現地の表示が違えば、係員に聞いてから進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 段差と休憩を確認し表示が違えば係員に聞いて進むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check level changes to the boarding point and remember rest spots. If local signs differ, I will ask staff before continuing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check level changes and rest places and ask staff before proceeding if signs differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では地図に経路の目印を付けましょう。ご自分のペースで向かってください。荷物と一緒に、どうぞ気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us mark landmarks for the route on the map. Go at your own pace. Take care with your luggage and have a safe trip.
